content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that gains are similar from about 5 to 30 reps per set, as long as the sets are taken close to failure (roughly 0 to 3 reps left in the tank). Heavy loads aren't required, but your sets do have to be hard.

💡 Your goal is a 100 kg bench press, and that's a strength skill. Heavy sets of 3 to 6 reps practice the lift best, so you'll want to include them. Use moderate reps of 8 to 12 on your accessory work for muscle growth with less joint stress.
